violation_type.title: Special Handling Procedures for Get-Well Care - Garbage Covered (26 TAC §746.3123(2))
violation_type.short_title: Special Handling Procedures for Get-Well Care - Garbage Covered
violation_type.typical_finding: Garbage bin was observed with out a lid in one of the restrooms.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the garbage bin with out the lid from the restroom.

finding_variants.text: Garbage bin was observed with out a lid in one of the restrooms.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the garbage bin with out the lid from the restroom.
It was observed during inspection a garbage bin in the Pre-K room was seen to not have a lid.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the garbage bin from the area.
Garbage cans in the children's restrooms did not have a lid, making the garbage accessible to the children.
